data.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:
Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $1.9B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers.

While many in the tech scene are scaling back, our DACH team continued to perform above 100% last year. We are looking for territory owners who want to manage deal cycles from €10k to €300k, selling a complex suite of 15+ products to 8 different personas, including MDs and Finance Directors. If you want to be pushed to your limit and rewarded, this is the place.

Whilst the role can be worked remotely anywhere in Germany or London, UK, there is a need to visit clients in the region as required (typically fortnightly basis).

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role you will:

    • Own your destiny: Operate as a pure revenue leader, responsible for 80-90% net-new logo acquisition through self-sourced pipeline.
    • Get In Early: The DACH Mid-Market is a high-achieving segment in the company. The window to build something significant is open right now. 
    • Sharpen Your Edge: Access elite enablement — Command the Message and MEDDPICC coaching — built to make you a more effective closer.

Minimum Requirements for the role:

  • Winning DNA: Min.18 months in a full-cycle, outbound-heavy SaaS closing role. You must have a proven history of building your own pipe from scratch.
  • Over-achievement: A track record of hitting and exceeding quota in a competitive, complex environment
  • Strategic Grit: Experience managing multi-stakeholder deal cycles and technical POCs. We value your ability to hunt
  • Native German language speakers

Advantageous:

  • Intellectual Curiosity: You are eager to learn the inner workings of diverse industries, from waste management to food distribution, to better align our technology with their operational pain.
  • A Repeatable Sales Framework: You don't rely on luck or intuition. You have a structured methodology that delivers success and you understand that consistent, high-quality inputs lead to predictable results.
  • A Data-Minded Approach: You are a student of your own funnel. You understand how to structure your activity—prospecting volume, discovery depth, and multi-threading—to ensure a consistent output and forecast accuracy.
  • Continuous Process Iteration: You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You are someone who actively seeks feedback, iterates on their approach, and understands that evolving your tactics is the only way to stay ahead of the market.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Der Deutsche Hilfsbund e.V. (DEHIB) bündelt Hilfsorganisationen und macht soziales Engagement wirtschaftlich schlagkräftig und systemisch wirksam. Unsere Initiative verbindet Verbände, entwickelt professionelle, leistungsfähige und zukunftsfähige Organisationsstrukturen und baut bundesweit eine Plattform für gesellschaftliche Wirkung auf.

Zur Unterstützung unseres Communication-Bereichs suchen wir eine kreative, kommunikationsstarke und umsetzungsorientierte Persönlichkeit als Social Media & Community Manager. Du erzählst unsere Geschichten, machst gesellschaftliche Wirkung sichtbar und baust eine engagierte Community rund um den DEHIB auf.

Mit deiner Arbeit trägst du dazu bei, die Bekanntheit und Reichweite des DEHIB zu steigern, neue Ehrenamtliche zu gewinnen und unsere Projekte, Veranstaltungen und Partner sichtbar zu machen. Gleichzeitig sorgst du dafür, dass unsere Kommunikationskanäle kontinuierlich und professionell bespielt werden und unsere Zielgruppen regelmäßig relevante Inhalte erhalten.

Hinweis

Die Tätigkeit ist ehrenamtlich, unvergütet und begründet kein Arbeits- oder Beschäftigungsverhältnis. Sie eignet sich insbesondere für Studierende aus Marketing, Kommunikation oder Medienmanagement sowie für Berufseinsteiger:innen, die praktische Erfahrung in Social Media, Content Management und digitaler Kommunikation sammeln und ausbauen möchten.

Der zeitliche Einsatz liegt bei ca. 4 bis 6 Stunden pro Woche. Die Zusammenarbeit ist vollständig remote und unbefristet bzw. langfristig angelegt. Für aktuelle Postings und Community-Anfragen ist eine möglichst zeitnahe Erreichbarkeit wünschenswert.

Aufgaben

  • Erstellung von Inhalten zu Projekten, Veranstaltungen und Verbandsthemen für LinkedIn und weitere digitale Kanäle
  • Redaktionsplanung, Pflege des Redaktionsplans und Veröffentlichungsmanagement
  • Pflege und Aktualisierung der Website sowie Veröffentlichung von Website-Inhalten
  • Kommunikative Begleitung von Roundtables, Veranstaltungen und Webinaren
  • Erstellung einfacher Grafiken sowie von Bild-, Grafik- und Präsentationsmaterialien
  • Community Management und Kommunikation mit Interessierten
  • Monitoring von Reichweite und Kennzahlen

Qualifikation

  • Interesse an Social Media, Marketing und Kommunikation sowie erste praktische Erfahrungen in Content Creation, Social Media oder Marketing sind wünschenswert
  • Sicherer Umgang mit LinkedIn sowie Kenntnisse in Canva, Microsoft 365 und WordPress sind wünschenswert, aber nicht erforderlich
  • Gespür für Zielgruppen, Trends und digitale Kommunikation
  • Gute schriftliche Ausdrucksfähigkeit in deutscher und englischer Sprache

Benefits

Gestaltung & Verantwortung

  • Hoher Gestaltungsspielraum bei Social Media, Website, Content und Community Management.
  • Direkter Einfluss auf Sichtbarkeit, Reichweite und Bekanntheit des DEHIB.
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Communication-Bereich, Fachbereichen, Vorstand und Ehrenamtlichen.

Exklusives Netzwerk

  • Zugang zu einem wachsenden Netzwerk aus Wirtschaft, Politik, Wissenschaft und Non-Profit-Organisationen.
  • Zusammenarbeit mit Unternehmer:innen, Führungskräften und Expert:innen unterschiedlichster Fachrichtungen.
  • Möglichkeit, das eigene berufliche Netzwerk nachhaltig auszubauen.

Persönliche & fachliche Entwicklung

  • Praktische Erfahrung in Social Media, Content Creation, Community Management und digitaler Kommunikation.
  • Ausbau deiner Kompetenzen in Redaktionsplanung, Reichweitenaufbau und zielgruppengerechter Kommunikation.
  • Erfahrung in der kommunikativen Begleitung von Projekten, Veranstaltungen und Verbandsthemen.

Unterstützung durch den DEHIB

  • Strukturierte Einarbeitung in Kommunikationskanäle, Themen, Abläufe und digitale Zusammenarbeit.
  • Fachlicher Austausch mit dem Communication-Bereich und weiteren DEHIB-Fachbereichen.
  • Zugriff auf das Know-how der angeschlossenen Organisationen und Kooperationspartner.

Sichtbarkeit & Reputation

  • Sichtbare Mitarbeit an der digitalen Kommunikation einer bundesweit tätigen Organisation.
  • Wertvolle Referenz für Social Media, Content Management, Community Building und Non-Profit-Kommunikation.
  • Qualifiziertes Ehrenamtszeugnis und Tätigkeitsnachweis.

Flexibilität

  • Vollständig remote organisierte Zusammenarbeit.
  • Flexible Zeiteinteilung bei einem Umfang von ca. 4 bis 6 Stunden pro Woche.
  • Unbefristet und langfristig angelegte ehrenamtliche Rolle.
  • Moderne digitale Zusammenarbeit über Microsoft 365.

Sinn & Wirkung

  • Aktiver Beitrag dazu, die Bekanntheit des DEHIB zu steigern und gesellschaftliches Engagement sichtbar zu machen.
  • Unterstützung bei der Gewinnung neuer Ehrenamtlicher und der Aktivierung unserer Community.
  • Kommunikative Begleitung gesellschaftlich relevanter Projekte und Veranstaltungen.

Ein Anschreiben ist gerne gesehen. Daraus sollte hervorgehen, welche ersten Erfahrungen du in Social Media, Content Creation, Marketing, Veranstaltungs- oder Projektkoordination mitbringst, mit welchen digitalen Tools du bereits gearbeitet hast und weshalb dich eine ehrenamtliche Mitarbeit als Social Media & Community Manager beim Deutschen Hilfsbund motiviert.

DIU ist führender IT-Dienstleister mit einer über 25-jährigen Tradition. An unseren zwei Büro-Standorten in Hamburg und Wiesbaden sowie deutschlandweit remote entwickeln und integrieren wir IT-Lösungen auf höchstem Niveau.

Zu unseren langjährigen Kunden zählen unter anderem OTTO, R+V Versicherung, Allianz Trade, Suzuki, Deutsche Telekom oder dpv Deutscher Pressevertrieb.

DIU ist geprägt von einer Kultur der Innovation und des Glaubens an die Kraft von Technologien als zentraler Baustein für den Erfolg von Unternehmen. Gestalte jetzt mit uns die Zukunft der IT getreu unseres Mottos: Unleash your power in IT.

Mehr zu uns bei DIU findest du hier: www.diu.digital/

Aufgaben

WANTED

Wir glauben fest daran, dass gute Beziehungen der Kern für nachhaltige Erfolge sind – besonders im Mittelstand. Für den Aufbau und die operative Weiterentwicklung unserer Kundengewinnung im MarTech-Umfeld suchen wir daher einen Sales & Consulting Manager B2B (m/w/d) – jemanden, der Vertrieb nicht als Zahlenspiel versteht, sondern als Beziehungsarbeit.

Wir schreiben die Position im Raum Hamburg im Hybrid-Modell mit 1-2 Tagen Office je Woche aus. Dein Team ist auf die Standorte Hamburg und Wiesbaden (und Umgebung) verteilt und arbeitet schon länger in dieser Besetzung zusammen, denn wir stellen Teams nach Fachgebiet und Interesse zusammen - nicht nach Wohnort. Um die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Familie zu stärken ist die Stelle sowohl in Voll- als auch Teilzeit z.B. in einer 4-Tage-Woche ausfüllbar.

DOINGS

  • Du verantwortest den gesamten Kundendialog – von der Erstansprache über die technische und fachliche Bedarfsanalyse bis zur Übergabe ins Projektteam
  • Du führst Erst- und Discovery-Gespräche, in denen du gezielt nachfragst, um sowohl die technische Ausgangslage (Systeme, Datenflüsse, bestehende MarTech-Tools) als auch das dahinterliegende Business-Problem unserer Ansprechpartner:innen zu verstehen
  • Du identifizierst relevante Unternehmen aus Handel, Versicherung und weiteren Branchen mit komplexen Content- und Marketing-Prozessen und sprichst Entscheider:innen in Marketing, IT und Digital gezielt an
  • Du baust und pflegst ein Netzwerk aus Empfehlungen, Partnern und bestehenden Kundenbeziehungen und ergänzt es durch gezielte Direktansprache
  • Du setzt KI-gestützte Automatisierung für Zielgruppenanalyse, Lead-Qualifizierung und CRM-Pflege ein, statt Vertrieb rein manuell zu betreiben
  • Du koordinierst Termine mit Geschäftsführung und Consultants, bereitest Kundengespräche inhaltlich vor und behältst Follow-ups im Blick
  • Du entwickelst Vertriebs- und Beratungsmaterialien mit – von der Positionierung bis zur kundenspezifischen Präsentation
  • Du spielst Kundenfeedback aus Erstgesprächen direkt ins Consulting- und Projektteam, damit unsere Lösungsvorschläge von Anfang an treffsicher sind

Qualifikation

KNOWHOW

  • 2–5 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb, Consulting, Partner Management oder Business Development, idealerweise im MarTech-, Software- oder IT-Umfeld
  • Technisches Grundverständnis für digitale Marketing- und Content-Prozesse (Marketing Automation, Content-Management, Schnittstellen/APIs) und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Themen authentisch und klar zu vermitteln
  • Du hörst genau hin und kannst aus einem Gespräch sowohl das technische Problem als auch das dahinterliegende Business-Anliegen herausarbeiten – dir reicht "wir brauchen ein neues Tool" nicht als Antwort
  • Freude an ehrlicher Kommunikation, vertrauensvoller Zusammenarbeit und persönlichem Beziehungsaufbau statt reinem "Abschluss-Denken"
  • Hohe Selbstorganisation, Strukturdenken und Umsetzungskompetenz – gute Vorbereitung und verlässliche Follow-ups sind für dich selbstverständlich
  • Intrinsische Motivation und echtes Interesse, gemeinsam mit dem Team nachhaltige Kundenbeziehungen und hohe Zufriedenheit zu erzielen
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse

Benefits

DIU FOR YOU

Bei DIU besetzen wir nicht Stellen, sondern suchen nach Menschen mit Leidenschaft für ihr Fachgebiet. Wir verstehen uns als Plattform für ein Team aus Menschen, die ihre Leidenschaft mit anderen teilen oder in Projekte einbringen möchten. Den Rahmen für diese Arbeit schaffen wir mit:

  • Einer agilen Unternehmensorganisation
  • Einer offenen Fehler- und Gesprächskultur
  • Einbeziehung tiefer fachlicher Themen in Management-Entscheidungen

DIU SPIRIT

Wir sind nicht laut - sondern lieber unaufgeregt und verlässlich. Wir entwickeln DIU bewusst strukturiert weiter. Bei uns findest du:

  • Sehr durchmischte Altersstrukturen
  • Eine gute und geregelte Gehaltsstruktur
  • Fachabteilungen für unsere Kerntechnologien / Gleichgesinnte

GET IN

Jobbeschreibung

bonial hilft Dir dabei Zeit, Geld und Papier zu sparen. Wir sind ein digitaler Werbepartner für das Offline-Business. Wir unterstützen Händler:innen in deren Marketing-Aktivitäten und helfen dabei, neue Kund:innen zu gewinnen.

Würdest Du gern dazugehören und Teil des digitalen Wandels im Handel sein?

bonial ist Teil der Axel Springer SE und revolutioniert den Einzelhandel als führender "Drive to Store"-Partner in Deutschland und Frankreich. Über unsere Plattformen " " und " " in Deutschland sowie ““ in Frankreich verbinden wir täglich Millionen von Nutzer:innen mit ihren Lieblingsgeschäften und -marken – und schaffen dabei echten Mehrwert.

Wir befinden uns in einer spannenden Wachstumsphase, skalieren rasant und verändern die Art und Weise, wie Menschen den Einzelhandel entdecken. Bei bonial arbeiten wir in einem leistungsstarken, dynamischen Umfeld, das von motivierten, ergebnisorientierten Menschen geprägt ist, die mit Leidenschaft etwas bewegen wollen.

Wenn Du Teil eines engagierten Teams sein möchtest, das die Zukunft des Einzelhandels gestaltet, freuen wir uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

Bei bonial sorgt unser People Operations Team dafür, dass sich Mitarbeitende und Führungskräfte während der gesamten Employee Journey auf reibungslose und mitarbeiterorientierte Prozesse verlassen können. Dabei verbinden wir operatives Anpacken mit dem Anspruch, unsere Zusammenarbeit und unsere Abläufe kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Aktuell wechseln wir von Personio zu SAP HCM – ein wichtiger Schritt für unser Team und für die Art, wie wir unsere People-Prozesse gestalten. Hier kommst Du ins Spiel: Als unser:e (Mid–Senior) People Operations Manager:in übernimmst Du die Verantwortung für alle People Operations Themen in Deinem festen Betreuungsbereich, begleitest die Einführung von SAP HCM und hilfst uns, den Übergang für das gesamte Team so reibungslos wie möglich zu gestalten. Dabei arbeitest Du eng mit unseren People Business Partner:innen, Payroll sowie weiteren internen und externen Stakeholder:innen zusammen.

Die Position ist ab dem Startdatum zunächst auf ein Jahr befristet.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für alle People Operations Themen in Deinem festen Betreuungsbereich und bist eine verlässliche Ansprechperson für Mitarbeitende und Führungskräfte.
  • Du steuerst unsere zentralen administrativen Prozesse entlang der Employee Journey – von Verträgen und Bescheinigungen über das Abwesenheitsmanagement bis hin zu Visa-Prozessen gemeinsam mit unserer externen Agentur.
  • Du verantwortest die Vorbereitung unserer monatlichen Gehaltsabrechnung und arbeitest eng mit unserem externen Payroll-Dienstleister zusammen, damit die Abrechnung korrekt und pünktlich erfolgt.
  • Du spielst eine aktive Rolle bei unserem Wechsel zu SAP HCM und unterstützt aus People-Operations-Perspektive bei Datenqualität, Prozessgestaltung, Tests und Dokumentation.
  • Du sorgst dafür, dass neue Prozesse im Arbeitsalltag ankommen: Du teilst Wissen, unterstützt das Team und stellst einen reibungslosen Übergang sicher, ohne das Tagesgeschäft aus dem Blick zu verlieren.
  • Du hinterfragst bestehende Prozesse, erkennst Möglichkeiten zur Vereinfachung und setzt deine Ideen in pragmatische und nachhaltige Lösungen um.
  • Du behältst Änderungen im Arbeitsrecht und Best Practices im People-Operations-Bereich im Blick und leitest daraus klare Maßnahmen für bonial ab.
  • Als Teil des Teams unterstützt Du regelmäßig unsere Bürotage und Vor-Ort-Termine, zum Beispiel Onboardings und Unterschriftentermine.

Stellenanforderungen

Dein Profil:

  • Du bringst umfangreiche Berufserfahrung in People Operations, HR-Administration oder einer vergleichbaren generalistischen HR-Rolle mit.
  • Du verstehst, was gute Datenqualität, verlässliche Prozesse und ein reibungsloses Tagesgeschäft brauchen – und wie diese Themen zusammenspielen.
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, übernimmst Verantwortung und bringst Struktur und einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch in deine Themen.
  • Du bist hands-on, lösungsorientiert und hast Freude daran, Veränderungen gemeinsam mit dem Team zu gestalten.
  • Du kommunizierst souverän mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholder:innen und bleibst auch bei komplexen Themen ruhig und konstruktiv.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (min. C1) und gute Englischkenntnisse (min. B2), sodass Du auch in unserem internationalen Umfeld sicher zusammenarbeiten kannst.
  • Du verfügst über fundierte und aktuelle Kenntnisse im deutschen Arbeitsrecht sowie praktische Erfahrung in der vorbereitenden Gehaltsabrechnung.
  • Idealerweise hast du bereits eine HR-Systemeinführung, eine Prozessmigration oder ein vergleichbares Transformationsprojekt begleitet. Erfahrung mit SAP HCM ist ein großes Plus.

Was wir Dir bieten können:

High-Growth Story – bonial ist ein wachstumsstarkes und dynamisches Unternehmen mit dauerhaftem Potenzial für die Zukunft. Wir sind eines der führenden Unternehmen und eine treibende Kraft in einer Branche, die gerade einen massiven, einmaligen Wandel von Print zu Digital erlebt.

Innovation & Tech – Wir sind ein High-Tech-Unternehmen mit Fokus auf innovative Technologien. Wir nutzen KI und andere Tools, um Produktivität und Effizienz zu steigern. Damit verbessern wir kontinuierlich die Leistung unseres Unternehmens und aller, die hier arbeiten – und erzielen gleichzeitig Ergebnisse für unsere Kund:innen und Nutzer:innen.
Spannendes Umfeld für Deine berufliche Entwicklung – Wir unterstützen Dich stark in Deiner beruflichen Entwicklung, gestützt von einer Feedback-Kultur, die Dir hilft, Deine Stärken und Chancen zu erkennen.

Diversität - Wir sind stolz darauf, ein Arbeitsplatz für Chancengleichheit zu sein, an dem wir es jeder Person ermöglichen möchten, ihr wahres selbst zu zeigen. Wir setzten uns für gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten ein, und dafür, ein Safe Space zu sein unabhängig von ethnischer Herkunft, Religion, Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Alter, Behinderung, Gender, Geschlechtsidentität oder Geschlechtsausdruck.

Wohlbefinden - Für uns ist mentale Gesundheit genauso wichtig wie Fitness. Deshalb bieten wir Dir einen kostenlosen Zugang zu nilo.health, einer App für mentale Gesundheit, an. Außerdem brauchst Du Dir keine Sorgen um Deine Rente machen, denn wir bezuschussen Deine betriebliche Altersvorsorge. Zusätzlich zu unserem internen Fitnesstudio, übernehmen wir auch einen Teil der Kosten für Urban Sports Club.

Nachhaltigkeit - Dir liegt das Thema Nachhaltigkeit am Herzen? Uns auch! Zusammen mit unserem Green Team bieten wir Dir die Möglichkeit, Dich in Projekten zu Nachhaltigkeit und Umweltschutz zu engagieren. Gemeinsam wollen wir unseren Beitrag leisten und den Planeten so positiv beeinflussen, wie wir nur können.

Flexibilität – Aktuell haben wir eine Regelung, die wöchentlich bis zu 20% mobiles Arbeiten innerhalb Deutschlands ermöglicht. Dazu darfst Du 30 Tage pro Jahr aus dem Ausland arbeiten. Zusätzlich bieten wir 28 Urlaubstage. Pro Kalenderjahr kommen ein weiterer Urlaubstag hinzu (bis zu maximal 30 Tage) sowie zusätzliche freie Tage für besondere Anlässe (z. B. Umzug, Mitarbeit an einem sozialen Projekt etc.).*

Modernes Büro - Wir haben ein eigenes und voll ausgestattetes Fitnessstudio, eine Dachterrasse für Team Events und Mittagspausen in der Sonne, sowie Zen Rooms, in denen Mitarbeitende beten, entspannen oder einfach eine ruhige Minute finden können.

Kostenloses Mittagessen - Wenn Du im Büro bist, bieten wir Dir verschiedene Optionen für ein Mittagessen an, und das Mittagessen geht auf uns! Du kannst in dem nahliegenden Partner-Restaurant essen gehen! Natürlich sind auch heiße sowie kalte Getränke, Obst und andere Snacks im Büro für unsere Mitarbeiter:innen kostenlos.*

Soziale Kultur - Ein gutes Miteinander ist uns wichtig, weshalb wir Wert auf eine Kultur legen, die dazu einlädt, miteinander ins Gespräch zu kommen, gute Arbeitsbeziehungen aufzubauen und sich gemeinschaftlich an Projekten zu beteiligen. Wir bieten außerdem regelmäßig optionale Events an, um dies weiter zu unterstützen.

Partner für den Handel – Wir ermöglichen es Händler:innen, ihre Kund:innen auf die effizienteste und wirkungsvollste Weise zu erreichen. Wir sehen uns als wichtigen Geschäftspartner für den Handel und – wie in unserer Unternehmensvision betont – „Bereichern wir das lokale Einkaufen für alle. Jeden Tag.“

Als Teil der Axel Springer Gruppe orientieren wir uns zusätzlich an den .

data.description:
A definitive shift is currently happening. Corporates across the globe are no longer just reporting on sustainability; they are actively investing in it as a core financial and strategic asset.

At CEEZER, we are architecting the infrastructure for enterprise-grade Climate Performance Asset management, transforming how the world's largest companies source and manage carbon credits, Energy Attribution Certificates (EAC), and Sustainable Aviation Fuel certificates (SAFc).

Our platform gives the world's most ambitious enterprises the data-driven precision, real-time monitoring, and framework-compliant reporting required to confidently deploy capital toward high-impact Climate Performance Asset portfolios and true, measurable climate action.

We are looking for a highly motivated Director/VP of Product (f/d/m). You will report directly to company leadership, lead a small and senior product team, and work hand in hand with our SVP Tech in a collaborative, fast-moving, VC-funded startup.

Our revenue is concentrated in a small number of large, long-term commitments. What we sell is certainty: that a portfolio we design today still holds in five years. The platform is how that promise stays credible as the number of deals grows faster than the team. Owning whether that holds is the job.

Your mission

  • Own our product strategy and hold it against the business: where we win, where we lose, where margin can grow and where we can run more efficiently, tested against deal data, RFP outcomes, customer conversations and delivery obligations, and revised when the evidence says otherwise.

  • Act as a strategic counterpart to our leadership team on commercial mechanics: what drives revenue, how spread and gross margin actually behave, and what is really behind renewal and retention.

  • Lead and develop our product team across product management and design, from mid-level to principal. Set a high quality bar and build it with the team through hands-on review of the work.

  • Drive prioritization together with the product team: decide what gets built, dropped and sequenced based on data, make the trade-offs explicit to leadership, and grow each PM's ability to make these calls on their own.

  • Turn complex cross-functional workflows spanning sales, risk screening, sourcing, operations and finance into a platform that opens up new growth and makes the business we already have more efficient.

  • Partner closely with our SVP Tech on architecture, data and automation, and set the strategy and priorities for our data and automation work together. Bring enough technical depth to shape sequencing, cost and trade-offs together.

  • Spend real time with enterprise buyers and internal teams to understand the procurement and portfolio lifecycle first-hand.

What you need to succeed

  • Curiosity for a complex scientific, operational and financial domain, and the drive to build rare expertise in a market still being defined.

  • 8+ years in product management, including 3+ years leading PMs and designers in complex B2B, marketplace, fintech, logistics, procurement or other regulated and operationally heavy environments.

  • Proven experience with products where the workflow is the product and part of the delivery is a human service.

About us

Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.

That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world.
If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what's broken — you'll find people here who work exactly in the same way. And together, you'll build something worth being proud of.

What you'll be doing

As our Legal Counsel, you'll provide high-level legal guidance within the Fintech sector, particularly in payments, e-money, and consumer credit products, offering strategic counsel on regulatory, contractual, and product-related matters to ensure compliance and mitigate risks.

Here's what that looks like in practice:

  • Product development support – Collaborate cross-functionally to design and launch new products and services in Payments and Consumer Credit (such as BNPL), integrating basic technical and engineering considerations into legal analysis.

  • Risk assessment & management – Identify legal and regulatory risks, proposing effective mitigation strategies aligned with our risk appetite to safeguard the organisation.

  • Regulatory compliance – Advise on relevant financial regulatory requirements, including PSD2, AML/KYC, e-money regulations, and CCD2, ensuring adherence.

  • Stakeholder management – Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, providing pragmatic legal guidance and fostering a culture of legal awareness across the organisation.

Who we're looking for

This role needs someone strategic, analytically strong, and equipped with deep fintech and payments regulatory knowledge to navigate complex legal frameworks.

  • Relevant education – Qualified lawyer with a minimum of 5 years PQE, and ideally 8–10 years of professional legal experience.

  • Relevant technical and regulatory knowledge – Deep knowledge of financial and consumer credit regulations (PSD2, AML/KYC, EMRs, CCD2) and a demonstrable track record in Fintech and Payments, ideally with experience in both private practice and in-house settings.

  • Analytical mindset – Ability to dive deep into complex legal issues, exercise strong judgment, and make sound risk-based decisions.

  • Technical and commercial awareness – Clear understanding of basic technology and engineering processes in Fintech, Payments, and consumer lending, with prior experience working with technical teams being a significant plus; ability to balance legal risks with commercial considerations.

  • Language fluency – English fluency (both written and spoken) is essential, while knowledge of Italian or French is a plus for effective communication within our international context.

We believe in equal opportunities for all and ensure that our hiring process complies with the highest standards of non-discrimination and inclusivity. Wer wir sind

Die GBC Group GmbH ist eine inhabergeführte IT-Unternehmensgruppe mit über 500 Mitarbeitenden an mehr als 10 Standorten in Deutschland. Nach dem Buy-and-Build-Prinzip vereinen wir 12 spezialisierte Tochtergesellschaften unter einem Dach, jede mit eigener Expertise und einer gemeinsamen Vision. Wir verstehen uns als starker IT-Partner für den deutschen Mittelstand und bieten unseren Kunden ganzheitliche Lösungen entlang der gesamten IT-Wertschöpfungskette: von Managed Services über Cloud-Infrastruktur bis hin zu IT-Security.

Was uns antreibt? Der Anspruch, mittelständische Unternehmen mit maßgeschneiderter, zuverlässiger IT pragmatisch und partnerschaftlich nach vorne zu bringen.


Dein Wirkungsfeld

Als AI Consultant [m/w/d] machst Du aus Geschäftsprozessen belastbare Automatisierungs- und KI-Lösungen.
Dein Ausgangspunkt ist dabei nicht das Tool, sondern der Prozess. Du analysierst, wie ein Prozess tatsächlich funktioniert, zerlegst ihn in Trigger, Entscheidungen, Datenflüsse, Ausnahmen und Schnittstellen und identifizierst, wo Automatisierung und KI einen messbaren und sinnvollen Mehrwert schaffen.
Anschließend übersetzt Du diese Erkenntnisse in robuste Workflows und AI-gestützte Lösungen. Du verbindest Fachbereiche, IT und Management, triffst technische und konzeptionelle Entscheidungen und sorgst dafür, dass aus einer Idee eine produktiv nutzbare Lösung wird.


Deine Aufgaben & Verantwortung

  • Geschäftsprozesse analysieren, strukturieren und Automatisierungspotenziale identifizieren
  • KI- und Workflow-Lösungen mit Tools wie n8n, Make oder Zapier konzipieren und umsetzen

  • LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, Tool Calling und Agentic Workflows sinnvoll in Prozesse integrieren
  • Fachliche Anforderungen in klare technische Lösungen übersetzen
  • Lösungen eigenständig von der Idee bis zum produktiven Einsatz verantworten
  • Ergebnisse messen, bestehende Automatisierungen verbessern und skalierbar machen
  • DSGVO, AI Act und Governance-Anforderungen von Beginn an berücksichtigen


Was Du mitbringst

  • Ausgeprägtes Prozessdenken und ein solides Verständnis von Prozessmodellierung
  • Erfahrung mit Low-Code-/No-Code-Automatisierung, idealerweise n8n, Make, Zapier oder Power Automate
  • Gutes Verständnis von BPMN, APIs und Datenstrukturen
  • Praktisches Verständnis von LLMs, Prompt Engineering und LLM-APIs
  • Idealerweise Erfahrung mit RAG, Tool Calling und Agentic Workflows

ABOUT US

METYCLE: where innovation meets sustainability
We are reshaping the global secondary metals industry to accelerate the circular flow of metals. By combining global trading, advanced processing and digital intelligence, we make secondary metals more predictable, transparent and scalable, strengthening industrial supply chains and reducing reliance on primary metal production.
And the impact is significant: recycling aluminium can reduce greenhouse gas emissions by up to 95% compared with primary aluminium production.
And we take it further! Our SmartSorting Hubs combine advanced sorting technology, automation and AI to transform how complex scrap is processed, turning selected mixed streams into better-defined industrial feedstock while improving material quality and traceability.Join us at a defining stage as we bring the $600 billion scrap metals industry into the 21st century and build a new global standard for secondary metals.


READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT?

We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst who turns complex operational and business data into clear insights, better decisions, and measurable improvements. You bring strong hands-on experience in data analysis, SQL, visualisation, and working with large and imperfect datasets - and understand how to connect data to real-world processes and business outcomes.
This is an integrated role at the intersection of business, operations, and technology. You’ll work directly with teams to understand their data needs, dig into the details hands-on, and find the right way to answer their questions - whether through SQL, Excel, dashboards, or other tools. You’ll also translate recurring needs into requirements for Engineering and help build stable, automated reporting and analytics over time, particularly across our trading business.
Join our international team and play a key role in shaping innovative solutions for scrap metal processing - using data and technology to build a more efficient and sustainable future.


YOUR MISSION

  • Analytics & Insights: Turn complex business questions into clear, actionable analysis, identifying trends, opportunities, risks, and the key drivers behind business performance. Work directly with the people who have the data need to understand their questions, challenge assumptions, and turn raw data into meaningful insights and decisions.
  • Data Foundations: Build and maintain the data transformations needed to turn raw data into clean, reliable, analysis-ready datasets in the Data Warehouse. Work hands-on with imperfect data, validate its accuracy and meaning, and identify gaps or inconsistencies in how data is captured.
  • Data Modelling: Translate business requirements into well-structured, reusable data models and clearly defined metrics that provide a trusted source of truth for analytics across the organisation.
  • Data Quality: Implement and maintain data quality checks and tests to ensure data is accurate, consistent, complete, and fresh - proactively identifying and resolving issues with relevant stakeholders and working with Engineering to improve how underlying data is captured.
  • Reporting & Self-Service: Build and support dashboards, reports, and analytical datasets that are intuitive, performant, and optimised for internal reporting and self-service analytics. Help turn recurring analytical needs and ad-hoc analysis into stable, scalable, and increasingly automated reporting.
  • Stakeholder Partnership: Work closely with Product, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Engineering, and other teams to understand business needs, challenge assumptions, and translate them into meaningful analytical questions and solutions. Communicate effectively across different levels and functions, from discussing detailed data questions with technical teams to presenting clear insights and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
  • Documentation & Standards: Maintain clear documentation for datasets, transformations, metrics, and data lineage using dbt Docs or similar tools, and contribute to practical standards for SQL, data modelling, testing, and visualisation.
  • Automation & AI: Identify manual or inefficient analytical workflows and improve them through automation, modern data tooling, and AI-assisted analysis - using AI to accelerate data exploration, querying, documentation, and reporting while maintaining a strong understanding of and control over the underlying data.


YOUR PROFILE

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in Data Analytics, Product Analytics, Business Analytics, or a closely related analytical role, with a track record of turning complex business questions and raw data into reliable analysis, actionable insights, and business decisions
  • Strong analytical and statistical thinking, with the ability to identify trends, anomalies, and root causes, define meaningful metrics, challenge assumptions, and work confidently with imperfect or incomplete data
  • Independent, structured, and pragmatic, with a strong sense of ownership. You are equally comfortable working with business stakeholders and engineers, communicate clearly across different levels and functions, and can bridge the gap between business needs and technical solutions. You are also genuinely curious about AI-assisted analytics and modern cloud data workflows, while maintaining full control of and understanding of the underlying data
  • Strong business understanding and analytical curiosity, with the ability to quickly grasp the essentials of a complex, finance-driven business, understand how the underlying processes work, and translate business needs into meaningful analytical questions. Experience with financials, commodity trading, finance analytics, or accounting is a strong advantage
  • Strong SQL skills with experience working with complex datasets, data transformations, joins, aggregations, window functions, and analytical data models
  • Proven experience working with modern Data Warehouses such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks, or similar, including building and maintaining clean, reliable datasets for analysis and reporting
  • Experience with modern analytics engineering practices and tools such as dbt, including data modelling, automated data quality tests, documentation, and data lineage
  • Strong experience with BI and visualisation tools (e.g. Metabase, Looker, Tableau, Power BI or similar), with a focus on building clear, performant dashboards and enabling self-service analytics


WHY JOIN US?

  • You will have the opportunity to challenge the status quo and work on an innovative venture with significant impact
  • You will be able to take ownership and shape the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions at an early stage
  • We offer a competitive salary including virtual company shares
  • We offer an environment with flat hierarchies and a steep learning curve with exciting growth opportunities

data.description:
ABOUT US

METYCLE - where innovation meets sustainability

We are building the B2B online platform to accelerate the global circular flow of secondary metals. By connecting buyers and sellers of scrap metal globally, we enable efficient trade of secondary metals and drive the seamless flow of recycling material, essential for reducing CO2 emissions by up to 95% compared to primary metal production.

And we take it further! We are pioneering an innovative Smart Sorting Facility that leverages AI, machine learning, and robotics to transform how scrap metal is processed, enhance material quality, improve traceability, and drive the recycling industry into the digital era.

Join us at the early stage in bringing the $610 billion scrap metal trading industry into the 21st century and in shaping the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions.


READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT?

If you are passionate about industrial automation, solving complex technical challenges, and building something from the ground up, join our team as an Industrial Automation Engineer.

The machinery is the easy part to buy. The control system that turns it into a plant - and the standards, documentation, and data that keep it running - is what we are hiring you to own.

We are looking for an experienced Industrial Automation Engineer to take ownership of our plant’s control systems from design through commissioning and into stable production. You bring deep hands-on experience in programming and commissioning industrial control systems and are comfortable taking responsibility for the PLC, safety systems, HMI, industrial networking, and interfaces between multiple machine suppliers.

Beyond programming, you understand what it takes to make a plant genuinely reliable in production and have the technical confidence to hold suppliers to high professional standards. Join our international team, help build innovative solutions for scrap metal processing, and contribute to a more sustainable future.


YOUR MISSION

  • PLC & Plant Control: Design, write, and own the PLC program using Siemens TIA Portal / S7-1200 & S7-1500, including control logic, sequencing, fault handling, and HMI
  • Commissioning & Production: Take the plant from design through commissioning to a stable, running line, owning the full journey through FAT/SAT and the hands-on work required to make the plant genuinely reliable
  • Plant Availability: Design stop and interlock behaviour to minimise unnecessary downtime — allowing unaffected parts of the plant to keep running when it is safe to do so. Plant availability is a direct business outcome here, and you will directly influence it
  • Machine Safety: Implement the machine-safety control concept on a fail-safe F-CPU with F-I/O, including the hardwired e-stop loop, PLC-enforced zone isolation that cannot be overridden, guard interlocks, and controlled, sequenced shutdown
  • Safety & Compliance: Be our in-house technical counterpart on EN ISO 13849 performance-level determination and the CE file, working with external assessors while retaining ownership of the technical approach and decisions
  • Machine Integration: Integrate control systems from several different machine suppliers into one coherent line, so that a single stop is genuinely a single stop across the whole plant
  • Supplier Management: Hold machine builders and panel builders to specification, including unlocked code, complete documentation, and standards compliance
  • OT / IT & Industrial IoT: Get plant data out over OPC UA / MQTT / Modbus TCP into our own systems, so stoppage reasons, energy use, and throughput become actionable data. Work closely with our Industrial IoT team, who own the edge and data side of that boundary


YOUR PROFILE

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience programming and commissioning industrial control systems, with a track record of bringing production equipment or complete lines into stable operation
  • Deep Siemens TIA Portal / S7-1200 & S7-1500 experience, with strong skills in SCL, LAD/FBD, HMI/SCADA, industrial networking (PROFINET, PROFIBUS, Modbus TCP), drives/VFDs, and fault-finding
  • Strong machine safety competence, including F-CPU / Safety Integrated and EN ISO 13849, with the ability to explain and defend performance-level determinations
  • Comfortable reading electrical schematics and troubleshooting cabinets, hardware, signals, wiring, and control behaviour directly on the shop floor. You have brought at least one production line from commissioning into stable production; maintenance-only experience is not sufficient
  • Experience working with machine and panel builders, with the confidence to hold suppliers accountable for code quality, documentation, standards compliance, and professional delivery
  • Experience with brownfield projects and legacy migration (STEP 7 Classic → TIA); experience in bulk material handling, recycling, sorting, or minerals processing is a plus
  • Experience with PLC version control, simulation / digital twins, or structured automation approaches is desirable. Additional IT/OT skills such as Python, C#/TIA Openness, SQL, Linux, Docker, MES/IIoT, OT network segmentation, or IEC 62443 are a plus
  • Independent, structured, and hands-on, with a strong sense of ownership. You challenge assumptions, hold suppliers to a high standard, and document what you build
  • Fluent in English; German and/or Dutch is a plus. Ideally based in or near Cologne or the Benelux/border region, with valid EU work authorisation and the willingness to travel to our Smart Sorting Facility in Belgium, Maasmechelen


WHY JOIN US?

  • You will have the opportunity to challenge the status quo and work on an innovative venture with a significant impact
  • You will be able to take ownership and shape the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions at an early stage
  • We offer a competitive salary including virtual company shares
  • We offer an environment with flat hierarchies and a steep learning curve with exciting growth opportunities

Du bist PTA und möchtest dein pharmazeutisches Fachwissen nicht nur anwenden, sondern gezielt weitergeben und echten Mehrwert schaffen?

Du suchst eine Rolle, in der du Menschen überzeugst, Wissen vermittelst und nachhaltige Ergebnisse erzielst.
Dann werde Teil unseres Teams und unterstütze die Haleon Markenwelt rund um Voltaren, Fenistil und Vitasprint.
In dieser abwechslungsreichen Rolle genießt du Benefits wie Firmenwagen, flexible Arbeitszeiten, Tagesschichten und keine Wochenendarbeit.


Deine Aufgaben – vielseitig und eigenverantwortlich:

  • Trainings und Wissensvermittlung:
    Planung und Durchführung von Vor-Ort-Trainings in Apotheken sowie vertiefender Schulungen zu Produkt- und Verkaufsthemen.
  • Produktexpertise:
    Vermittlung fundierten Wissens zur Haleon Markenwelt (u. a. Voltaren, Fenistil, Vitasprint) sowie Unterstützung bei der optimalen Platzierung und Präsentation im Handverkauf und Sichtwahlbereich.
  • Qualitäts- & Kompetenzentwicklung:
    Nachhaltige Weiterentwicklung der Beratungsqualität im Apothekenteam mit dem Ziel, die aktive Empfehlung am Point of Sale zu stärken.
  • Markt- & Wettbewerbsbeobachtung:
    Kontinuierliche Analyse von Marktentwicklungen, Wettbewerbsaktivitäten und Trends im Apothekenumfeld sowie Einbringung relevanter Insights ins Team.
  • Projektarbeit & Weiterentwicklung:
    Mitarbeit bei der Entwicklung von Trainingskonzepten, Webinaren und weiteren Lernformaten sowie kontinuierlicher Ausbau der eigenen fachlichen Expertise.


Warum du bei uns arbeiten solltest:

  • Work-Life-Balance: 
    Freue dich auf feste Arbeitszeiten ohne Schichtdienst und Wochenendarbeit, zusätzliche freie Tage an Heiligabend und Silvester sowie flexibler Gestaltungsspielraum für deinen Arbeitsalltag.
  • Mobiles Arbeiten & Ausstattung: 
     Im Außendienst sind unsere Teams mit Tablet und Smartphone bestens ausgestattet, um jederzeit und überall einsatzbereit zu sein. Mit einem Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte, der auch privat genutzt werden kann, sorgen wir dafür, dass der Point of Sale schnell und sicher erreicht werden kann.
  • Sicherheit & Wachstum: 
     Als Deutschlands größte inhabergeführte Sales und Retail Agentur bieten wir dir langfristig einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz.
  • Corporate Benefits: 
     Wir arbeiten für die großen Marken und Händler. Über unsere Corporate Benefits kannst du attraktive Rabatte für ausgewählte Marken.
  • Was uns auszeichnet:  
     Wir stehen für Toleranz, Offenheit, Respekt und Integrität – Werte, die Vielfalt fördern und ein vertrauensvolles Miteinander stärken. Mit Freude, Mut und Verantwortung schaffen wir eine inspirierende Kultur, die Innovation und nachhaltiges Handeln vereint.
  • Onboarding-Days: 
     Wir laden dich in unser Office ein, geben dir einen Überblick über deinen Joballtag, stellen dir die wichtigsten Ansprechpartner vor und lassen dich die TMS-Kultur hautnah erleben!


Deine Stärken und Skills:

  • Fachliche Qualifikation & Erfahrung:
    Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als PTA bildet die Grundlage, ergänzt idealerweise durch erste Erfahrungen im Training, in der Beratung oder im Außendienst.
  • Fachkompetenz & Branchenverständnis:
    Fundiertes pharmazeutisches Wissen, gutes Verständnis regulatorischer Anforderungen sowie Kenntnisse des Apothekenmarkts und betriebswirtschaftlicher Zusammenhänge.
  • Kommunikation & Präsentationsstärke:
    Sicheres Auftreten, ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten sowie die Fähigkeit, Inhalte verständlich und zielgruppengerecht zu vermitteln.
  • Arbeitsweise & Mobilität:
    Strukturierte, eigenständige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise kombiniert mit gutem Zeitmanagement und hoher Reisebereitschaft innerhalb der Region (inklusive Führerschein Klasse B).
  • Lernbereitschaft & Weiterentwicklung:
    Hohe Motivation zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung, regelmäßige Teilnahme an Trainings und Fachveranstaltungen sowie eigenständige Erweiterung des fachlichen und vertrieblichen Know-hows.

data.description:
YOUR MISSION

YOUR MISSION
Ready to rethink nutrition? At yfood, we’ve been pioneering good food for everyday life since 2017, offering balanced, convenient, and truly delicious options. With our products, we’ve created an entirely new category: Smart Food. Active across Europe, growing fast, and always on the lookout for fresh ideas. If you want to be part of a dynamic team that’s revolutionising the food industry, yfood is the place for you.

As Influencer Marketing Manager for the UK, you will be responsible for adapting and executing yfood’s influencer marketing strategy to grow the brand’s digital presence and drive measurable business impact.
You will work across performance-focused platforms, developing authentic partnerships that strengthen brand visibility while delivering against performance and brand objectives.
As part of the UK marketing team, you will also contribute to refining influencer acquisition strategies, processes, and tools to ensure scalable, efficient, and high-impact partnerships.

Your responsibilities as an Influencer Marketing Manager UK

  • Localise and execute yfood’s influencer marketing strategy across Instagram, YouTube, Twitch and TikTok in the UK market.
  • Identify, source and onboard creators of all sizes, building a strong and diverse influencer network aligned with the brand.
  • Develop creative campaign concepts and briefs that enable creators to produce authentic, high-performing content.
  • Manage the end-to-end execution of influencer collaborations, including outreach, negotiation, contracting, briefing, approvals and campaign execution.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with influencers, talent managers and UK-based agencies, acting as a trusted partner for long-term collaborations.
  • Manage campaign KPIs, ensuring performance is tracked, analysed and continuously optimised.
  • Support performance initiatives such as affiliate collaborations, discount code tracking, whitelisting/paid amplification and creator-led paid media, where relevant.
  • Monitor campaign results and compile regular reporting on influencer performance, sharing insights and best practices across markets.
  • Work closely with marketing, product and retail teams to ensure influencer activity aligns with broader brand campaigns and commercial priorities.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

Your skills as an Influencer Marketing Manager UK

  • A degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field
  • 2–3+ years of hands-on experience in Influencer Marketing, ideally managing campaigns and creator partnerships independently
  • Strong knowledge of the UK social media and influencer landscape, including relevant platforms, creators, trends, and audiences
  • A proactive, structured, and independent way of working, with the ability to take ownership of projects from planning through execution
  • A strong commercial and analytical mindset, with experience working towards clear KPIs and using performance data to inform decisions
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with confidence in negotiating and managing influencers, agents, and external partners
  • Fluent English (C2 or native-level), with an excellent understanding of UK culture, communication style, and tone of voice
  • A collaborative mindset and the confidence to communicate your perspective, challenge ideas constructively, and manage different stakeholder expectations

WHAT DRIVES US

We’re a little different, and that’s exactly what makes us who we are:

  • Passion: We’re passionate about what we do. Full of energy, optimism, and hungry for what’s next.
  • Responsibility: We have each other’s backs, take responsibility, and give it our all when it really matters.
  • Professionalism: We take our work seriously, but not ourselves too much. We’re open, straightforward, and always on equal footing. No bullshit, no egos. Just teamwork.
  • Innovation: We prefer “Why not?” over “That’s how it’s always been done.” We love new ideas, unconventional approaches, and never stand still

(WH)yfood?

What we offer - Our Benefits

  • We promote equal opportunities and value diversity. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
  • yfood goes international. Although Germany is our home base, we have created a dynamic and colorful environment with our international markets, where many exciting topics are waiting for you.
  • Agility is key. That's why we work in a hybrid work model and offer you the opportunity to work with Workation from other EU countries.
  • Vacation is important. That's why we give you 30 days of paid vacation per year.
  • yfood keeps you fit. We offer a monthly sports allowance of €30 to support your wellbeing. For this purpose, we offer workshops and campaigns (e.g. Yoga, Breathwork, Soccer, Pickleball) as part of our health management & Healthy@yfood
  • Train your taste buds. Everyone who wants to is part of our Sensory Team. So try new products, varieties or flavors before anyone else. Otherwise, there's as much yfood as you can carry, for free of course in all our offices but also if you work remotely.
  • As a start-up you often have to fight with clichés. But some of them are true. That's why we also offer a fruit basket, your free caffeine kick or the still water.
  • Come as you are. Whether in a suit or unicorn onesie. We do not have a dress code.

data.description:
Technical Sales Engineer

This is a future role. We're building a shortlist now and will contact you when it opens.

About us

Foundational is building the most precise picture of Earth and orbit, using lasers fired from the ground. We call it ground truth for orbit.

We design and run low-cost, autonomous satellite laser ranging stations. They measure the distance to satellites with extreme precision, day and night. Our data platform turns those measurements into tracking data and orbit products for satellite operators, space agencies and governments. We also build our own flight-proven laser retroreflector arrays, so any satellite can be tracked.

Our station network is expanding across Europe, South America, Africa and Australia. The data supports resilient navigation, Earth observation and the safe, sustainable use of space.

We're a small, fast-moving team of engineers, scientists and operators in London. We're backed by venture investors and supported by ESA, the UK Space Agency, Innovate UK and the European Innovation Council.

Position Overview

London · Full time · On-site

You'll be the technical voice in our sales conversations. You'll help satellite operators understand what laser ranging data and our retroreflectors can do for their missions.

What you'll do

  • Run technical discovery calls and demos with prospective customers

  • Scope solutions: which tracking tier, which data products and which retroreflector

  • Answer technical requirements in RFPs and supplier questionnaires

  • Support customers as they integrate retroreflectors onto their spacecraft

  • Feed customer needs back to product and engineering

  • Build technical sales material: case studies, data samples and integration guides

What you'll bring

  • An engineering or physics background, ideally in space

  • Experience in technical sales, pre-sales, applications engineering or systems engineering

  • The ability to explain complex ideas simply, to engineers and executives alike

  • Comfort travelling to customers and conferences

Nice to have

  • Satellite operations, GNSS, space situational awareness or ground segment experience

  • Knowledge of laser ranging or retroreflectors

  • Experience with CRM tools

What We Offer

  • A high-impact role with real ownership at an early-stage, venture-backed spacetech company

  • EMI share options (UK employees)

  • 25 Days Annual Leave + Bank Holidays

  • Enhanced Parental Leave

  • Cycle to work schemes

  • Work alongside engineers and scientists across optics, lasers, software and astrodynamics

  • Offices in central London, with snacks, tea, coffee and regular socials

We actively champion underrepresented groups and seek to bridge gaps in our workforce. If you're excited by the role but don't match every point, or you’re seeking a part time role, please apply anyway and add a note into your application. Building the best team is our priority.

London · Full time · On-site

  • Build processing pipelines that take ranging data from raw returns to normal points and higher-level products

  • Develop statistical methods for bias detection, outlier rejection and data quality

  • Analyse station and network performance, and find where it can improve

  • Work with our geodesy and orbit determination team to turn research into products

  • Turn analysis into clear reports, plots and customer-facing metrics

What you'll bring

  • A degree in geodesy, physics, maths, data science or similar (MSc or PhD preferred)

  • Strong Python and the scientific stack (NumPy, pandas, SciPy)

  • Solid statistics: estimation, time series and uncertainty

  • Experience with large scientific datasets

  • A habit of writing production code, not just notebooks

Nice to have

About us

Encord is the universal data layer for AI that helps 300+ AI teams train and run models on the right data. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates, and evaluates data across the full AI lifecycle, from development through production.

 

Trusted by Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath, Zipline, and more. We're an ambitious team of 100+ working at the frontier of AI and have raised $60M in Series C funding from Wellington Management, CRV, Next47 and Y Combinator.

The role

Encord is a fast-growing company building the data infrastructure layer for AI teams. We work with leading enterprises across autonomous vehicles, healthcare, robotics, and generative AI. Our product team is small, high-calibre, and operating in green-field territory. The data layer for AI is still being defined, and you will help define it.

As Product Lead, you will own a meaningful slice of the product, spanning the core platform experience, data curation and exploration layer, and drive it from strategy through to customer outcomes. You will lead and grow a team of Product Managers, setting direction, raising the bar on craft, and multiplying your impact through them. You will work closely with Engineering, ML, Design, and Customer Success, and play an active role in Encord's enterprise go-to-market motion.

This is a high-autonomy role for someone who is comfortable making independent decisions and driving them through, and who can build a team that does the same.

The Opportunity: Just as LLMs were unlocked by massive text datasets, the next wave of breakthroughs in self-driving vehicles, robotics, drones and generative AI requires building entirely new datasets and human feedback pipelines that don't yet exist. Encord is the platform the world's most ambitious AI teams use to build them, and you'll be helping define what that platform looks like.

Hard and Complex Problems: There is no playbook for what the data layer for AI looks like. You'll be solving novel problems across your product areas: from core platform (tooling that scales from a 10-person startup to a 500-person AV team) to data curation (helping customers turn floods of raw data into high-signal training datasets).

Ownership and Growth: Product is represented at the highest levels at Encord. You'll have real ownership: setting strategy, making calls, driving them through, and building the team that executes. As one of the most senior product people in the company, your impact is visible and your trajectory is accelerated.

What you'll do

  • Own and manage the product roadmap across your areas, ensuring alignment with company goals, KPIs, and enterprise customer needs

  • Manage, coach, and develop Product Managers: setting clear goals, giving regular feedback, reviewing their specs and decisions, and accelerating their growth.

  • Set the standard for product craft across the team: discovery, prioritisation, spec quality, and shipping cadence

  • Lead customer discovery, interviews, problem validation, webinars, and demos, translating complex pain points into clear, winning product bets

  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success to drive upsell, cross-sell, and expansion within our largest enterprise accounts

  • Collaborate with Engineering and Design to ship high-quality features at pace, writing tight specs, making clear tradeoffs, and holding a high bar for what ships

  • Play a leading role in building a high-performing, collaborative product management culture as the team grows

Experience requirements

  • Experience in product, ideally including time at a rapidly scaling startup. You have seen an organisation scale and know what good product looks like at each stage

  • Experience managing or formally mentoring other product managers, or a clear track record of leading through others and a strong desire to step into people management

  • Proven experience on B2B SaaS products or technical products sold to enterprise customers. You understand the enterprise sales motion, expansion, and how product decisions connect to revenue

  • You speak in metrics and impact, not features shipped. You have worked closely with GTM teams and can tie product decisions to business outcomes

  • A self-starter who makes independent decisions and drives them through. You want ownership, not just input. You are energised by ambiguity, not paralysed by it

  • You love speaking to customers. You are curious about hard problems at the frontier of AI, and you anticipate needs before customers can fully articulate them

  • Excellent communication skills for leading internal sessions and external engagements, customer interviews, demos, and stakeholder presentations

Encord encourages people from all backgrounds, cultures, and skill levels to apply. You don't need to meet every requirement. We are looking for people who are passionate, customer-focused, and eager to learn.

data.title: Product Lead

data.description:
About Encord

Encord is the universal data layer for AI. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates and evaluates multimodal data across the full AI lifecycle, from development to production, for 300+ AI teams including Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath and Zipline.

Encord was founded by former computer scientists, physicists and quants who saw first-hand how poor tooling for training data slows AI progress. We're a Series C company backed by CRV and Y Combinator, with 150+ people across London, San Francisco and New York.

The role

Most engineers never get to redesign core infrastructure for the next 100x of scale. On Foundations, that's the job.

AI teams are generating video, images, 3D sensor data and documents faster than anyone's systems can keep up. Help us build the high-performance data systems behind the AI data platform for robotics and beyond.

You'll join Foundations, the backend backbone of Encord. We build the reliable, scalable, fast systems every other team and every customer runs on. The work sits deep in distributed and data-intensive systems: storage, indexing, querying and processing multimodal data at a scale few companies ever reach.

The timing is rare. A year ago we were a team of 100; now we're over 150 and still accelerating, driven by massive demand. We are building the team to unlock our next orders of magnitude of scale and capability.

What you'll do

  • Own significant projects in our data systems end to end: design, architecture, deployment, monitoring and measuring the impact you made

  • Build distributed systems that stay fast and correct under load, and reason carefully about every way they can fail

  • Shape performant protocols and APIs, that customers build directly on top of

  • Find simple solutions to complex domains at scale, and know when boring technology wins

  • Raise the bar for everyone around you through code reviews, pairing and sharing what you know

Why engineers join Foundations

  • Scale that's genuinely hard. Multimodal AI data is big, messy and growing fast. You'll solve problems most backend engineers only read about.

  • Real ownership. You'll own whole systems, not tickets, and the architectural calls are yours to make.

  • Work that ships. Your systems power 300+ AI teams, including Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath and Zipline.

  • Long-term thinking. A team that plans 24 months out and gives you room to build things properly.

  • The right moment. A Series C company growing fast, early enough that your decisions shape the platform for years.

Who we're looking for

  • You've seen and built a lot. You have personally developed and maintained multiple systems from scratch, and you know what trade-offs are involved in building reliable, performant software at speed

  • You combine rigorous engineering with ruthless prioritisation to ship efficient and correct systems quickly.

  • You're happy to tackle problems without a predefined, clear definition or obvious solution, and are excited to have autonomy to make decisions as you go

  • You understand that being a member of a high-performing team requires two things. You contribute your best work and help others contribute their best. You'll always lend a helping hand when needed and level up those around you

Experience requirements

  • Fluency in at least one high level (Python, Typescript), and one imperative statically typed (Rust, C++, Java, Go, or other)

  • Solid grounding in distributed systems concepts (databases, replication, partitioning, queuing, caching, consistency) and how they behave under load

  • Deep understanding of CS fundamentals, data structures and algorithms

  • Experience owning services in production and improving quality through code reviews, testing, rollout and monitoring

Why Encord

We started building Marshmallow in 2017. Since then, we’ve grown from 3 to 700+ people, gained unicorn status, raised ~£140M over three funding rounds, turned profitable, insured millions of drivers and lent millions in car loans.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal is to become one of the largest financial services providers in the world. Over the next 10 years we’ll grow exponentially, not only by scaling our existing products, but also by building new ones.

To achieve our goals we need incredibly ambitious, commercially driven people who never settle for ‘good enough’. Marshmallowers are hungry for autonomy and ownership, and would rather improve than coast. Everyone raises standards and has an impact, with a focus on collective success over self-interest.

We’ve created an environment where curious, tenacious people win and grow together. If that sounds motivating, this could be the place for you.

About the team

Our Large Loss Specialists handle Marshmallow’s most complex and high-value motor claims, often involving catastrophic injuries such as brain and spinal trauma, psychiatric injury, complex fractures and nerve damage.

Beyond handling claims, the team acts as a centre of technical expertise, sharing insights and driving consistency across Claims. We work closely with Complex Personal Injury colleagues, reinsurers, panel solicitors and teams across Claims, Underwriting and Pricing to deliver fair, commercially sound outcomes. As a small, highly technical team, we offer broad exposure and the opportunity to grow your authority quickly.

What you'll be doing

  • Managing a portfolio of high-value motor claims, typically valued above £250,000, through pre- and post-litigation.

  • Investigating liability, indemnity and coverage while setting proactive, commercial and empathetic claim strategies.

  • Reserving accurately for complex injuries and future losses, using the available evidence and tools such as PI Calc.

  • Identifying recovery opportunities (subrogation, contribution, and beyond) and ensuring they're actioned by the relevant teams.

  • Collaborating with panel solicitors, reinsurers and internal teams to reduce claim lifecycles, control legal spend and pursue recovery opportunities.

  • Shaping our Large Loss strategy while coaching colleagues and sharing technical knowledge across Claims.

We offer a flexible hybrid work model, with the team coming together at our London office once every month.

Your expertise

  • Strong experience managing high-value or catastrophic motor bodily injury claims with current authority of at least £250,000.

  • Deep knowledge of liability, indemnity, causation, reserving, future losses, the Ogden discount rate and complex medical issues.

  • Experience handling litigated claims and applying relevant procedures and frameworks, including CPR, PPOS and MIB technical disputes.

Who you are

At CoMind, we are developing a non-invasive neuromonitoring technology that will result in a new era of clinical brain monitoring. In joining us, you will be helping to create cutting-edge technologies that will improve how we diagnose and treat brain disorders, ultimately improving and saving the lives of patients across the world.


The Role:
CoMind One measures the brain from outside the skull. Fifteen scientists (optical physicists, signal processing specialists, physiologists) turn raw optical interference signals into continuous measurements of cerebral physiology a clinician can act on. What slows them down isn't the science; it's the engineering around it. The last head-to-head comparison of two novel methods took six weeks, and most of that had nothing to do with the methods. You'd design the architecture that fixes this: how data, compute, pipelines and evaluation fit together, and the standards that hold it in place. None of it exists yet in any deliberate form, so the shape is an open question. When it works, a scientist describes the comparison they want and gets back metrics, plots and a reproducible record from one command, or one prompt.


At CoMind, all team members work at least 4 days per week from our new Kings Cross offices, plus a flexible work-from-home day.


Responsibilities:
Problems, not specifications. How they get solved is yours to decide.

  • Reprocessing. Change one stage of the pipeline and you currently pay for a full re-run. Re-running a six-month-old analysis with new parameters should be routine and cheap.

  • Evaluation. Comparison and simulation harnesses are rebuilt bespoke every time. They should be something a scientist calls, not something a scientist commissions, including scientists who don't write code, and agents running analysis strands on their behalf.

  • Compute and data access. Reproducible environments, sensibly-sized cloud resource, and datasets you can find and trust without asking whoever made them.

  • Engineering standards. Testing, CI and repository structure across a codebase written largely by scientists. Knowing where to enforce and where to reduce friction instead matters more than the tooling does.

  • The research-to-software boundary. We already have a real interface contract with our software team, which is more than most research groups can say. It should become a gate a method passes, not an event that consumes weeks.

  • Regulatory evidence as a by-product. IEC 62304 traceability artefacts generated from CI rather than written alongside it.

  • Growing the capability. Mentoring junior developers in the team, and shaping this function as it grows.

AI is fundamental to our culture. It's not just a tool, but a core part of how we work, collaborate, and innovate. We expect all team members to embrace AI in their daily work and continuously find new ways to use it effectively.

  • Substantial software or platform engineering experience, a good deal of it building tooling for scientists, researchers or quants rather than for end customers

  • Deep Python, and pipeline or workflow systems where correctness and reproducibility mattered as much as throughput

  • Cloud compute and storage (AWS preferred), containerisation, infrastructure-as-code, cost-aware provisioning

  • Tooling you built that people chose to use. Adoption you earned rather than mandated is the strongest single signal for this role

  • The ability to sit with a scientist, understand the analysis well enough to abstract it correctly, and push back when the evaluation itself looks wrong

  • A record of raising the standard of the engineers around you without formal authority over them

  • Comfort defining a function rather than joining one, on a small team with a real deadline: shipping a usable road early and widening it, rather than designing the complete platform first
